components.css: .ds-dim { background: rgb(14 15 18 / 70%); padding: 40px; } .ds-slip { width: 420px; margin: auto; padding: 0 24px 40px 48px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0 33px, rgb(14 15 18 / 55%) 33px 34px) 0 76px / 100% calc(100% - 76px) no-repeat, #ede4d0; color: #0e0f12; font: 700 25px/34px 'Saira Extra Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-slip h2 { margin: 0 -24px 8px -48px; padding: 18px; background: #fff04a; font: 800 38px/1 'Saira Extra Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; transform: rotate(-3deg); } .ds-slip p { margin: 0; } .ds-warn { color: #ff2e3d; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-choices { display: flex; gap: 1.4em; margin-top: 34px; } .ds-choices button { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0 0.3em; color: #0e0f12; font: 700 1.15em/34px 'Saira Extra Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choices button[data-selected], .ds-choices button:hover, .ds-choices button:focus-visible { background: rgb(255 240 74 / 85%); outline: none; }

components.css: @keyframes ds-notice-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px) scale(0.96); } } .ds-hud { padding: 24px; background: #2a1830; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 16px; } .ds-notice { margin: 0; color: #fff04a; font: 800 72px/0.9 'Saira Extra Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; text-shadow: -2px 0 #0e0f12, 2px 0 #0e0f12, 0 -2px #0e0f12, 0 2px #0e0f12, 0 4px 10px rgb(0 0 0 / 45%); animation: ds-notice-in 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both; } .ds-place { padding: 4px 14px; background: #fff04a; color: #0e0f12; font: 800 40px/1 'Saira Extra Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 70%, 88% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-place small { font-size: 0.5em; }

narrative.overview:
Between races the player is in the Lowside, the bar where the career lives, and every screen is a room in it or something pinned to its wall. Ruled sheets with yellow tape across the top, cyan and magenta stickers, flyers, bills, and stencilled stamps sit on painted anime rooms: the bar, the garage, the back room, the car park. The art is painted and the words are live text set over it, so a name, a number, or a line can change without new art. The race view stays clean. The road is the brightest thing on screen, and the only interface that stays on it is one speedometer.

Every room is one fixed 1672 × 941 stage scaled to fit the window. Pieces sit at boxes measured from the approved comps and their type is sized against the stage width, so a room keeps its composition at any window size. Menus are lists written on paper, not buttons. The selected line gets a highlighter stroke of neon yellow, and the actions along the bottom strip get a neon-yellow outline.

Density is low. A room has one sheet of choices, one or two notes, one figure, and the strip. Keyboard first: arrows move, Enter takes the highlighted line, Escape goes back.
keyCharacteristics: Painted rooms on a fixed stage; text is code, set over the plates.
Ruled paper with yellow tape for every list, form, and written card.
Neon yellow marks where you are: the highlighted line, the outlined strip action, the name tape.
Saira Extra Condensed capitals for anything set; the stencil for the wordmark, verdicts, and stamps only.
No health bars. In the race, one speedometer and nothing else that persists.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Neon yellow means "you are here". On paper it is a highlighter stroke behind ink text; on ink it is the text and outline itself. Never use it to decorate.

rules.name: The Ink on Paper Rule
rules.body: Text on paper and tape is ink. The only other colour allowed on paper is a neon-red warning.

rules.name: The Ledger Colour Rule
rules.body: Money coming in is green with `+`, money going out is red with `−`, a zero is muted, and a balance is warm white unless it is negative. Amounts use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Stencil Is Paint Rule
rules.body: The stencil face is for the wordmark, outcomes, and stamps. A list line, a title, or a button never uses it.

rules.name: The Fixed Digits Rule
rules.body: A number that changes while the player watches uses tabular numerals, so a rising speed or a counting ledger never shifts the layout.

rules.name: The Painted Depth Rule
rules.body: If a piece needs to lift off the wall, paint it into the plate. A CSS shadow on a stage piece is a floating card; leave it out.

dos: **Do** build every room on the 1672 × 941 stage with `place` and `stagePx`, and keep the header, the pinned sheet, and the bottom strip where they are.
**Do** put every list, form, and written card on a ruled sheet, with text on the lines.
**Do** mark the current choice with the neon-yellow highlighter on paper, or neon-yellow text and outline on ink, and make everything reachable from the keyboard.
**Do** keep painted material in plates and text in code: names, numbers, lines, and notes are live text set over the art.
**Do** show new character or plate art to the user before wiring it in.
**Do** colour every amount by the Ledger Colour Rule and set it in tabular numerals.
**Do** check new pieces on `/kit` (development only), which lays out the pieces the game ships on the same stage.
donts: **Don't** add health, stamina, or bike condition bars to the race HUD. The speedometer carries speed, gear, place, and progress; the rider and the bike show damage themselves.
**Don't** make a second element blink. The cop warning is the only one.
**Don't** put a dark panel, a card, or a filled button on a room. Choices are lines on paper or actions in the strip.
**Don't** add CSS shadows to stage pieces; paint the depth into the plate.
**Don't** use the stencil face for anything but the wordmark, outcomes, and stamps.
**Don't** paint text into the art, and don't make a static painting for a menu: rooms change with the road, the rider, and the time of night.
**Don't** reach for retro low resolution, dithering, or blocky, toy-like stand-ins, and don't add coloured afterimages to turning riders. The user rejected all of them.
